def get_ranks(vals):
    indexed = sorted((v, i) for i, v in enumerate(vals))
    ranks = [0.0] * len(vals)
    i = 0
    while i < len(indexed):
        j = i
        while j < len(indexed) and indexed[j][0] == indexed[i][0]:
            j += 1
        avg_rank = ((i + 1) + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[indexed[k][1]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks
